en.title: Microsoft Edge: CVE-2026-126885
en.summary: A use-after-free vulnerability affects Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based), reported in the Microsoft 2026-Nov security update.
en.impact: The sources do not provide detailed impact information beyond the vulnerability type (use after free).
en.fix: The sources do not list fixed versions.
